newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FINMIN SETS 26-WEEK T-BILL AUCTION FOR WED.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FINMIN SETS 26-WEEK T-BILL AUCTION FOR WED.

text.p: The Czech central bank (CNB) on Tuesday set an auction for a 5.3 billion crown tranche of Finance Ministry 26-week T-bills for Wednesday, a CNB statement said.
Minimum price was set at 923,000 crowns for a one million crown bill, putting gross yield at 16.5 percent, and net yield at 12.375 percent.
Gross yield at the last auction of similar T-bills on April 9 was 11.49 percent.
